questions.question:
Choose the same address.

Sample: Tower-6, Flat 1102, Skyline Greens, New Town, Kolkata - 700156?

options.text: Flat 1102, Skyline Greens, New Town, Kolkata - 701056
Apt 1102, Skyline Greens, New Town, Kolkata - 700156
Tower-6, Flat 1102, Skyline Greens, New Town, Kolkata - 700156
Flat 1102, Skyline Greens, New Town, Kolkatta - 700156

questions.solution:
Given: Tower-6, Flat 1102, Skyline Greens, New Town, Kolkata - 700156

Option 1) __**Flat**__ 1102, Skyline Greens, New Town, Kolkata - 701056 → Incorrect

Option 2) __**Apt **__1102, Skyline Greens, New Town, Kolkata - 700156 → Incorrect

Option 3) Tower-6, Flat 1102, Skyline Greens, New Town, Kolkata - 700156 → Correct

Option 4) __**Flat**__ 1102, Skyline Greens, New Town, __**Kolkatta**__ - 700156 → Incorrect

Thus, the address in option 3 is exactly similar to the given address.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Find the odd one out:

6 + 7 = 13

2 + 3 = 5?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

6 + 7 = 13

13 = 13 (LHS = RHS)

And,

2 + 3 = 5

5 = 5 (LHS = RHS)

So checking each option one by one:

Option 1) 6 + 7 = 13

13 = 13 (LHS = RHS)

Option 2) 2 + 3 = 5

13 = 13 (LHS = RHS)

Option 3) 1 + 1 = 2

2 = 2 (LHS = RHS)

Option 4) 3 + 3 = 7

**6 ≠ 7 (LHS ≠ RHS)**

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Statement: All laptops are devices. Some devices are pricey. All pricey things are taxed.

Conclusions: I. Some devices are taxed. II. Some laptops are pricey?
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/044d2a30c5b9908a70013d3ae96e804bf608ce90f9b94d8e89a1aed704adf348.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some devices are taxed. → Follow (As some devices are pricey and all pricey things are taxed. As some part of devices is common with pricey which whole comes in taxed, therefore it is true.)

II. Some laptops are pricey → Does not follow (As all laptops are devices and some devices are pricey. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: If 6 workers take 6 hours to paint 6 walls, how long for 100 workers to paint 100 walls?
questions.solution:
Given: 6 workers take 6 hours to paint 6 walls

Rate of work per worker → 6 walls ÷ 6 workers = 1 wall per worker in 6 hours

So, 1 worker paints 1 wall in 6 hours

Thus, with 100 workers, each painting 1 wall each

∴ **100 worker paints 100 wall in 6 hours**

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:

II. All trucks are wheels.
questions.solution:

∴ Here, Neither follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
